properties.headline: Flood Watch issued September 23 at 3:39PM CDT until September 25 at 7:00AM CDT by NWS Midland/Odessa TX
properties.description:
* WHAT...Flash flooding caused by excessive rainfall.

* WHERE...A portion of southwest Texas, including the following
areas, Chinati Mountains, Davis Mountains, Davis Mountains
Foothills, Marfa Plateau and Presidio Valley.

* WHEN...Through Friday morning.

* IMPACTS...Excessive runoff may result in flooding of rivers,
creeks, streams, and other low-lying and flood-prone locations.
Flooding may occur in poor drainage and urban areas. Low-water
crossings may be flooded.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
- Additional rounds of numerous to widespread showers and
thunderstorms will develop over the Watch area this afternoon
through Thursday night. Heavy rainfall may quickly result in
areas of flash flooding.
- http://www.weather.gov/safety/flood
properties.instruction:
You should monitor later forecasts and be prepared to take action
should Flash Flood Warnings be issued.

NWSheadline: FLOOD WATCH IN EFFECT THROUGH FRIDAY MORNING
